resources.string: Learn the main flows and how to use FlashLearn
Choose a review goal from Home. Use Library to manage vocabulary and Settings for appearance and learning options.
Words can be added individually, in bulk, or restored from a backup file. These actions manage vocabulary data and do not own learning-state logic.
Review supports flashcards and multiple-choice quizzes. For audio quizzes, the question is always spoken in Spanish. Word Recognition uses Spanish answers; Meaning Recognition uses Persian answers.
Use Library to search, filter, and manage vocabulary and inspect concept details.
Settings controls appearance, language, and review options. Presentation settings must not change learning history or scheduling.
Replay repeats only the current question and does not create a new question or change the correct answer. Spanish voice availability depends on the device speech engine.
Help is a presentation and educational layer; it does not own learning state, difficulty, review history, or scheduling.
